context: Request: antitrust-practice matters where a deal was pushed through a second request to clearance, with the clearance documents. Rubric: 1041-00001 (Solara Digital) and its post-clearance-status-memo.docx, plus a precision criterion (1003-00003 also permitted).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a folder listing cut at 80 lines; reviewer said partly and flagged the capped listing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2); writes all matter folder names to a scratch file and prints them.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script times out; it reruns as four parallel scripts over ranges of the folder list, two of which time out, with outputs up to about 1.2M chars. Reviewer flagged uncapped output and unopened hit matters.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 2); capped snippet scripts over four named candidate matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for request words, counted per matter; a second pattern prints only a matter count.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Keyword-filtered file listing of nine candidate matters; reviewer flagged that most hit matters stayed unlisted.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads strategy memos, compliance letters and an outcome memo of the two matters it settled on, plus a full listing of one and its closing certificates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2. Lists one matter in full and reads a closing letter and a notice; reviewer still flagged a listed outcome memo as unopened.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two qualifying matters with their documents and a list of excluded candidates.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and checks that every cited path exists (the first script looked for the response at a path that does not exist).

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search within a candidate matter's files → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; reviewer said partly and recommended listing all matter folders.

stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2); counts matter folders and prints only the first 20 names.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script with broad terms times out after about 189K chars; the agent picks nine candidates from it. Reviewer flagged the uncapped output and recommended writing results to a file with narrow terms.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Parallel keyword-filtered listing and an uncapped snippet script over the nine candidates; the script returns about 4.8M chars and the run ends before a review.

runs.failure_point: After a timed-out store-wide scan it ran an uncapped snippet script over nine candidate matters; its 4.8M-char output filled the context and no response was written.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: The uncapped snippet-extraction script over nine candidate matters returned about 4.8M chars, filling the context before any deliverable was written.
first_error.critic_note: The run ended inside the stage; the previous review [19] had already flagged uncapped output and recommended writing results to a file.

stages.stage: List matter folders

stages.note: Lists all files of seven candidate matters picked from the file-name hits.

stages.note: Reads strategy memos, letters, trackers and an outcome memo of three candidate matters, plus one email of a fourth.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs listed the store, listed matter folders after the reviewer's prompt, and ran a store-wide extraction script that timed out. They split at the next stage: T0 re-ran the scan in matter ranges (which surfaced the matter it later answered with) and T2 switched to a file-name search that surfaced it; both then listed, read and answered with two matters. T1 picked nine candidates from its timed-out scan and ran an uncapped snippet script over them, whose 4.8M-char output ended the run (context overflow). The critic's review at the scan stage was similar in all three (partly; uncapped output, unopened hits); T1's review explicitly recommended capping output and writing to a file, which the agent did not follow, and no review followed the overflow.
